name: app-tilted-portfolio-dashboard-with-glow-line-and-allocation-cards
title: Tilted monitor with yellow-green glow line chart plus flat allocation and payout cards
whatItIs: A light grey board 'UI Design 02' with a large tilted monitor showing a yellow-to-green glowing chart line with a tooltip, allocation and payout panels, and below flat cards: Property Allocation with thin gradient bars, a nav of round icon buttons with dark green active, and Upcoming Payouts with date pills and amounts.
whatItMeans: Refined and calm; light type and gradient bars feel like a private wealth app.
techniques: Tilt the monitor to fill the frame.
Show hero chart as a glowing gradient line.
Present components flat below as documentation.
Use date pills and light rules in lists.

vocabulary.definition: A chart line with a luminous halo.
A thin gradient bar showing a share.
A small capsule with a date.
A board showing UI parts flat.
